name: docs-repair
description: Documentation repair skills. metadiscourse-audit — find and remove text whose subject is the document, its author or its reader rather than the thing it documents. ai-slop-audit — strip generation residue and the machine register from AI-written docs. lie-detector — verify the factual claims in a doc set against the code and keep a ledger of what settled each one, with a CI gate and per-sentence provenance.
